The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

Blackbird Health is doing something rare in pediatric behavioral health: scaling a coordinated, evaluation-through-medication-management model across four states in a single year, with more sites opening every quarter. That growth is a strength, but every new clinic is also a new seam — a new referral relationship with a local pediatrician, a new payer credentialing thread, a new place where a family's evaluation notes, therapy progress, and medication record need to line up perfectly with what the community providers around them are seeing.

The highest-leverage moment is now, while Blackbird Health is still building its clinical operating model, not after ten more locations are live on divergent processes.* Vorro sits underneath the clinical record as the interoperability layer — normalizing referral intake from pediatricians and schools, moving eligibility and prior-auth traffic to and from commercial payers, and giving every new site the same FHIR/HL7-based connective tissue from day one instead of retrofitting it later.

With Dr. Tang's quadruple board certification spanning child psychiatry, adult psychiatry, pediatrics, and addiction medicine now anchoring the clinical model, Blackbird Health has the credibility to standardize care across sites. Vorro gives that standardization a technical backbone — so a family's record, and the referral and payer data around it, move as cleanly as the clinical model itself does.
